notes.title: Towards The Pantheon is OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/3648878e5eaedca57b436039ec89c8cb36046753.gif[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/709510/Towards_The_Pantheon/]Towards The Pantheon is OUT NOW on Steam![/url][/b] 

Now that you've played [b]Towards The Pantheon: Escaping Eternity[/b], Join Freyja, Bam, Mishima, and Phenez on their journey [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/709510/Towards_The_Pantheon/]Towards The Pantheon[/url][/b]! Gone are the RPG cliches of potions and elemental powers; in [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/709510/Towards_The_Pantheon/]Towards The Pantheon[/url][/b] you dive head first into a simultaneously lighthearted, fun, dark, and painful adventure in this fresh and exciting world! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/298644845a5fbde82627627b3464a2b922395a28.gif[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/709510/Towards_The_Pantheon/]Towards The Pantheon[/url][/b] is a turn based 2D RPG with unique twists on the classic formula. Buy the game now to ride hamsters, journey through a survival horror inspired mansion, collect dead memories, eat copious amounts of sushi, and partake in regular chats around the campfire!

[b]Features include:[/b]

[list]
[*]Over 10 hours of gameplay including sidequests and myriads of secrets.
[*]Unlockable NewGame+ mode and cheat codes for additional replay value.
[*]Ability to switch between party members in the overworld to use their unique mechanics.
[*]An eclectic original soundtrack consisting of over 65 songs which incorporate elements from orchestral, noise, drone, breakbeat, and chiptune genres.
[*]A massive fully connected overworld with the ability to ride Speedsters to cut down on backtracking.
[*]Turn based combat system where each character has unique battle stats and mechanics.
[*]Collectible cards and combos found throughout the world that can be used during battle.
[*]More than 10 regions to explore including lush forests, cities full of kitties, electropunk metropolises, barren wastelands, and a dark mysterious mansion.
[*]Dialog and support systems that allow for further character development and stat boosts.
[*]A unique and complex overarching story line that ties together all subplots and backstories.
[*]Over 45 unique enemies and a dozen boss battles.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/640380e30c03a9ece91207f410ce324628309ef4.gif[/img]

[b]We hope you enjoy the game![/b]

notes.title: Towards The Pantheon releases May 16th! Add it to your Wishlist!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/d29d8030a680fb1ae6574e107f8bc6264157e9db.png[/img]

Hey everybody! Thank you all for checking out the short prequel game [b]Towards The Pantheon: Escaping Eternity[/b]. On [b]May 16th[/b], the full length 2D RPG [b]Towards The Pantheon[/b] will be releasing here on Steam!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/709510/Towards_The_Pantheon/][b]Click here[/b][/url] to check out the Steam page for it and [b]add it to your wishlist[/b]! Be sure to do so if you want to be notified when the game releases. Here's some info from the Steam page!

A group known as [b]The Sworn Light[/b] have slowly been gaining power throughout the world through divide and conquer tactics. While the humans, felines, electropunks, and ghosts begin to argue amongst themselves, [b]The Sworn Light[/b] are taking advantage of each situation in order to ultimately take control. One day a small village chief named [b]Wuotan[/b] summons his strongest warrior [b]Freyja[/b] to embark on a long and dangerous journey. Her mission is to trek towards The Pantheon to defeat the source of [b]The Sworn Light[/b] before the world falls into chaos. Along the way [b]Freyja[/b] will battle deadly enemies, encountered long forgotten horrors, and make new friends!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/3648878e5eaedca57b436039ec89c8cb36046753.gif[/img]

[b]Towards The Pantheon[/b] is a turn based 2D RPG with unique twists on the classic formula. Gone are genre standards of elemental types, elixirs, elves, inns, and generic love stories. Instead players of [b]Towards The Pantheon[/b] will ride hamsters, journey through a survival horror inspired mansion, collect dead memories, and partake in regular chats around the campfire.

Features include:
[list]
[*]Unlockable NewGame+ and cheat codes for additional replay value
[*]Ability to switch between party members in the overworld as each have unique mechanics.
[*]An eclectic original soundtrack consisting of over 80 tracks.
[*]A massive fully connected overworld with a transportation system to cut down on unnecessary backtracking.
[*]Turn based combat system where each character has unique battle stats and mechanics.
[*]Collectible cards and combos found throughout the world that can be used during battle.
[*]More than 10 regions to explore including lush forests, cities full of cats, dark electropunk metropolises, barren wastelands, and a dark and dangerous mansion.
[*]Dialog and support systems that allow for further character development and stat boosts.
[*]A unique and complex overarching story line that ties together all subplots and backstories.
[*]Over 45 unique enemies spanning all regions.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/59ccddf41b1f38fea067c58b3c56d5f3a7a55961.png[/img]

Development of [b]Towards The Pantheon[/b] began in 2016 when lead developer [b]Connor O.R.T. Linning[/b] read a list of RPG cliches and decided to design a game that would avoid as many as possible. Soon afterwards [b]Leandro Tokarevski[/b] joined in to create the pixel art using a palette of only 16 colors resulting in a vibrant and distinct world full of charm. [b]Towards The Pantheon[/b] is the result of big dreams and two grueling years of hard work.

Thanks for reading, and I look forward to hearing what you think of [b]Towards The Pantheon[/b] very soon!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/640380e30c03a9ece91207f410ce324628309ef4.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574663/44bcb9322270e361be32ad444e09233107af51ad.gif[/img]
